verdict.rationale: Airweave documents webhooks that push notifications to a registered endpoint when syncs complete or collections change, and a Pipedream integration whose actions can be triggered from Pipedream workflows. Neither is a first-party way to define event-to-action rules: webhooks are a developer building block, and the Pipedream workflow logic lives on a third-party platform. No native rules or automation engine is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
